mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Badger Ridge Middle School and a moderate air quality index of 56. We are currently under a new moon phase. Tonight, the temperature will dip to a comfortable overnight low of 69 degrees with no rain predicted.

Construction on Highway M west of the Highway PB intersection begins August 18, which will shift traffic patterns for the next few weeks. Additionally, the city is reviewing development plans for 201 South Main Street and the Sub-Zero expansion at Liberty Business Park.

You have plenty of local options today with trivia at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow brings even more community fun including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory.
Regarding the weekly police report, on Wednesday, August 5, officers arrested a 37-year-old Madison man on Whalen Road after he initially fled to avoid a probation warrant.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, Caramel Chocolate Pecan. The shop is open until 11 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
